_comment: The kinds of file a Wii U project holds. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one game: a Wii U archive (.wua, which may hold the game's update and its add-on content too), a zip of a game's NUS folder (its encrypted .app files with title.tmd, title.tik and title.cert; the Wii U common key, firmware, opens them) with, in a slot of its own, the zip of its add-on content's NUS folder, a homebrew bundle (.wuhb) or a program on its own (.rpx); and the console's saved games to start with, as Export Save Data wrote them.
